clue.text: They avoid friction by deportment during dances

indicators.note: during means one word sits within the span of the other, so the posture word goes inside the dances

parts.note: balls are formal dances
bearing is deportment, the way a person carries themselves

explanation.surface: Someone who glides through dances with good posture avoids any friction with fellow dancers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'during' puts the posture word inside the dances. The OCR had 'department'; the page prints 'deportment', an old word for how a person carries themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: Hardened steel spheres in a race let machine parts turn smoothly, reducing rubbing.

clue.text: City register written in good Latin

indicators.note: written in says one word is entered inside another, so the record goes within the Latin word

parts.note: bona is the Latin for good (feminine form)
a log is a register or record

explanation.surface: A city's register has been kept in good Latin.
explanation.definitionFit: An Italian city, capital of Emilia-Romagna, famous for its university.

clue.text: Failing to overtake on grass

parts.note: to lap a rival in a race is to overtake them a whole circuit ahead
to grass is slang for informing, as is to sing

explanation.surface: A runner stumbles while trying to pass someone on a grass track.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grass' looks like the track surface; it is the slang verb for informing on someone. In a down clue 'on' just puts LAP above SING.
explanation.definitionFit: Lapsing means slipping or declining, as a failing standard or a policy that runs out.

clue.text: Even the old boy could be the scorer

indicators.note: could be signals that the letters may be rearranged into something else

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Even an old boy of the school might turn out to be the top scorer in the match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be' rearranges EVEN THE plus O and B. 'scorer' suggests sport; here it is one who writes musical scores.
explanation.definitionFit: The German composer wrote symphonies, so he set music down in score form.

clue.text: Sang elegantly showing spirit

indicators.note: showing means the letters are on display within the words sang elegantly

explanation.surface: A singer performed beautifully and showed great spirit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'showing' signals letters on view inside 'Sang elegantly'.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavenly messenger is a spirit being, a supernatural creature.

clue.text: Light railway becoming lighter

parts.note: to light a fire is to ignite it

explanation.surface: A light railway is being upgraded into a lighter line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Light railway' reads as a type of line; split it into the verb 'Light' and the abbreviation R. 'becoming' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A device that sets fuel or a fire going is a lighter.

clue.text: The bird's message for David?

definitions.meaning: an order telling David to let fly with his stone at Goliath, split into two words

explanation.surface: A bird carries a message for someone named David.
explanation.walkthrough: In the Bible David killed Goliath with a stone from his sling, so the two-word command is what he would be told.
explanation.definitionFit: A young goose is a baby waterfowl; the second sense is a command urging David to fire his weapon.

clue.text: Midas's original plan for the Yuppie type

definitions.text: Midas's original plan for the Yuppie type

parts.words: Midas's original plan for the Yuppie type
parts.note: King Midas wished that all he touched would turn to gold, an instant fortune, the kind of scheme a Yuppie favours

explanation.walkthrough: Yuppies were the young upwardly mobile professionals of 1980s Britain and America, chasing fast money.
explanation.definitionFit: A scheme promising instant wealth, like Midas wanting gold from every touch.

clue.text: Loss of fame could be total

definitions.meaning: a fall from prominence, when someone is overshadowed
the astronomical event in which the moon blocks the sun may be partial or total

explanation.walkthrough: The second part hints at the solar event, which can be total.
explanation.definitionFit: Being overshadowed means lost renown; the astronomical blocking of the sun can be total.

clue.text: Source of character building is birth

parts.note: genes are the inherited material from which a person's character is built

explanation.walkthrough: 'Source of character building' sounds like upbringing or hardship; it is the genes, followed by IS.
explanation.definitionFit: The origin or coming into being of something, also the first book of the Bible.

clue.text: Appropriate conveyance for Greta Garbo?

parts.note: the film star famously wanted to be alone, so the right vehicle for her carries one person only

explanation.walkthrough: Greta Garbo, the Swedish-born film star, is remembered for the line 'I want to be alone'.
explanation.definitionFit: A car or aircraft with room for just one occupant, such as a racing car.

clue.text: Playful badger is rough

indicators.note: to badger is to harass, so the letters are pestered into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A playful badger is rough with its cubs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badger' looks like the animal; it is the verb meaning to harass, shuffling IS ROUGH.
explanation.definitionFit: Mischievous, like a rascal who teases.

clue.text: Valiant it ill-disposed citizen of Russia

indicators.note: ill-disposed means badly arranged, so the letters are put in a different order

explanation.surface: A brave but hostile citizen of Russia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ill-disposed' rearranges VALIANT. The clue dates from Soviet times, when the Baltic republic was part of the USSR; 'it' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from the Baltic state, then a Soviet republic ruled from Moscow.

clue.text: Family noted for noise

parts.note: a clan is a family group
G is a musical note

explanation.surface: A family famous for being noisy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'noted' looks like 'famous'; it gives a note, G.
explanation.definitionFit: A loud metallic ringing sound, as of bells or pans.

clue.text: Governor's deputy knocks back a drink

parts.note: vice means deputy, as in vice-captain

indicators.note: knocks back means the drink word is turned backwards

parts.note: lager is a drink

explanation.surface: The governor's deputy downs a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocks back' looks like drinking; it turns LAGER into REGAL. 'Governor's deputy' reads as one phrase, but the definition is just 'Governor's'.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to a viceroy, a governor ruling a colony on the monarch's behalf.

clue.text: Old timer taking the waters

parts.note: an ancient clock that measured time by water flowing out, not an elderly spa visitor

explanation.walkthrough: 'Old timer' suggests a veteran; 'taking the waters' suggests visiting a spa.
explanation.definitionFit: An ancient water clock, timing by the steady flow of liquid.

clue.text: Style of furniture attracts a royalty

definitions.meaning: the early 18th-century style of walnut furniture with curved cabriole legs
a royal person, the British monarch from 1702 to 1714

explanation.walkthrough: 'attracts' is only a link between the two senses.
explanation.definitionFit: Named after the early eighteenth-century monarch, the style marks walnut chairs with curved legs.

clue.text: You. I see. are said to accept the facts about breeding

indicators.note: to accept means one piece takes in the other, wrapping around it
are said means the words are heard spoken, giving letters that sound like them

parts.note: these words spoken sound like the letters U and I C
gen is British slang for information or the facts

explanation.surface: You and I, it is said, should accept the facts of breeding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'are said' turns the spoken words into letters that sound like them; 'to accept' wraps those round British slang for information. The page's full stops stand for commas.
explanation.definitionFit: Concerned with improving a population by controlled breeding.

clue.text: After the ball one may be left standing

definitions.text: After the ball one may be left standing

parts.words: After the ball one may be left standing
parts.note: not a wallflower after a dance, but a skittle still upright when the bowled ball has passed

explanation.walkthrough: 'ball' suggests a dance; it is the bowling ball, and one of the skittles may survive it.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the skittles in the bowling game, set up to be knocked down.

clue.text: Spots infiltrators

definitions.meaning: small dark marks on the skin

explanation.definitionFit: Small skin blemishes; also secret agents planted inside an enemy organisation.

clue.text: Italian who had a signal success

definitions.text: Italian who had a signal success

parts.words: Italian who had a signal success
parts.note: signal means notable, but also hints at radio signals sent by the Italian wireless pioneer

explanation.walkthrough: 'signal success' reads as 'remarkable triumph'; here it is literal, success with radio signals.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian inventor who sent the first transatlantic radio signal.

clue.text: Sort of slide from top of the Eddystone?

definitions.meaning: a magic projector slide, a glass picture shown by an early projector
the light housing at the top of a lighthouse

explanation.walkthrough: The Eddystone is a famous lighthouse on rocks off Plymouth, in south-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: A glass picture shown by an old projector; also the lamp room crowning a lighthouse.

clue.text: A stage role for genuine characters

indicators.note: characters are letters, here the letters of genuine put into a new order

explanation.surface: A theatre part written for genuine characters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'characters' looks theatrical; it means letters, rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: An innocent young woman, a stock part in plays.

clue.text: Unmarried men finding endless time in Paris leads to boredom?

indicators.note: un-married says the M for married is taken away

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: endless means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: nuit is French for night, the time of darkness

explanation.surface: Bachelors spending endless time in Paris end up bored.
explanation.walkthrough: M is the abbreviation for married, so 'Unmarried men' is MEN without M. 'endless' trims NUIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Listless weariness, a word borrowed from French.

clue.text: Lilac is no good in the country

indicators.note: in says the abbreviation sits inside the country

parts.note: Syria is a country

explanation.surface: Lilac grows poorly in this country.
explanation.definitionFit: The botanical name for lilac, also used for mock orange.

clue.text: It takes one important man to immobilise another

definitions.text: It takes one important man to immobilise another

parts.words: It takes one important man to immobilise another
parts.note: in chess a piece is pinned when moving it would expose the most important piece; also the key person in an operation

explanation.walkthrough: In chess a piece is 'pinned' when it cannot move without exposing the king behind it.
explanation.definitionFit: The chief person in an organisation, on whom all else depends.

clue.text: District controlled by a board member?

definitions.text: District controlled by a board member?

parts.words: District controlled by a board member?
parts.note: a board member sounds like a company director, but it is a chess piece, the bishop, who runs a district

explanation.walkthrough: 'board member' is a chess piece, the bishop, not a company director.
explanation.definitionFit: The area under a bishop's church authority.

clue.text: Analyse noise of the birds of northern Europe

parts.note: to scan is to analyse closely
din is a loud noise
avian means relating to birds

explanation.surface: Analysing the noise made by birds of northern Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Belonging to the Nordic region of Norway, Sweden and Denmark.
